svg.aria-label: The two arms of the lateness card: no-clock and no-expectation
svg.text: The lateness card names which silence it found
Two arms of a closed union. They never merge back into one sentence, and neither sends the reader to do something already done.
The four rungs carry expected durations — DEV 10, STG/TEST 10,
COC 10, PROD 10 days — but nobody has staged a record by hand.
0 of 1,551 records have a clock a person started
Move a record to its rung and its clock starts.
No rung carries a time yet
18 of 1,551 records have a person’s clock running, but not one
rung has an expected duration, so nothing here can be late.
0 of 4 rungs carry an expected duration
Give a rung an expected duration in settings.
Neither card ever prints “0 days late” or “0 at risk”: a measurement nobody took is not a measurement of zero. The union is closed — a third silence
breaks the switch at compile time rather than rendering a blank card.
